t: The Default Shape Card stores a shape, size, offset, and solid or hollow mode. Use it in the Builder to place blocks or in the Shield Projector to define a shaped shield.
默认塑形卡片用于存储形状、尺寸、偏移量及实心/空心模式。你可在构建器中使用它放置方块，或在护盾投射器中定义塑形护盾。
Right-click the card to edit shapes such as box, sphere, cylinder, cone, torus, prism, scan, or composition. Sneak-use can help select positions in the world.
右键卡片可编辑盒状、球状、圆柱状、圆锥状、环状、棱柱状、扫描或复合等形状。潜行使用可辅助在世界中精确定位。
